ModMetaData.name: SOS2 Weapon Readouts
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the missing per-shot information to Save Our Ship 2 weapons without changing their balance.
Built weapons append a compact (+X/shot) value to SOS2's existing network-heat line instead of adding another inspect row. Information cards and placement previews add only details SOS2 does not already show, including connection and capacity warnings.
